_comment:
Hand-curated optimal_swell_dir (true-north degrees, the swell bearing the spot works best on) for spots whose ray-cast value is wrong. Applied by pipeline/enrich.py as Algorithm 2d, AFTER Algo 2 (raycast), Algo 2b (orientation-derived fallback) and Algo 2c (tier preserve-guard) — so it is the LAST writer of optimal_swell_dir in enrich and beats every other source, LLM verification included. Slug derivation mirrors pipeline/db_import._slugify (via enrich._slug_for) so re-enrich looks up by the same key that lands in the spots table. Stored alongside spot_orientations.json: the durable, re-enrich-survivable override mechanism for optimal_swell_dir, which had none.

WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. interpret.directional_gain targets optimal_swell_dir and falls back to orientation_deg only when the optimal is null — so a hand-corrected orientation never reaches the rating on a spot that has an optimal. All ten spots below already carried orientation_source="manual" and still rated off a swell arriving from behind the land. The cause is the ray-cast: _first_seaward_entry returns "open" when a ray exits the spot's own landmass and never returns, which is correct for a seaward ray leaving a beach and wrong for a landward ray leaving a finite island — a continent blocks because the ray never escapes within the 3000 km fetch, an island does not. Honolua Bay scored dir_gain 1.000 on an 84-degree east swell that would have to cross the whole of Maui. Prior research concluded that binary ray-casting structurally cannot model refraction and that the answer is nearshore model output (CDIP MOP / NWPS), so this is a durable human override, NOT a raycast fix.

KNOWN LIMIT — THE RAYCAST HALF IS NOT GUARDED. pipeline/sw1_raycast.py:353 (_apply_raycast_result) writes spot["swell_window_arcs"] and spot["optimal_swell_dir"] unconditionally; its `preserve` flag gates only swell_window_source. sw1_raycast runs as its own workflow (.github/workflows/sw1-raycast.yml, mode=full) and writes spots_enriched.json WITHOUT going through enrich, so a full raycast run will still overwrite every value in this file. That guard was deliberately left out of round one: it cannot be verified until the next full raycast, which is rare. MITIGATION: after any `sw1-raycast mode=full`, re-run enrich so Algo 2d re-applies these values, and check the review-branch diff before merging it.

FRAME CAVEAT, TRUE OF EVERY VALUE BELOW. Each source describes the DEEP-WATER swell direction. optimal_swell_dir is compared against the model's direction at a nearshore node 1-4 km out (NWPS DIRPW, or the WW3 partition direction), which for a wrap-around spot may already be partly refracted toward the shore normal. The two frames can therefore differ systematically: most at spots sitting inside a bay behind a headland — lovers-point and monterey-beach, both inside Monterey Bay behind Point Pinos — and least at spots facing open ocean with no headland to bend around — hapuna-beach and suicide-s on the Kohala coast. If a later measurement shows the nearshore frame runs consistently offset from these deep-water bearings, revise the values here rather than changing the gain kernel.

ARCS ARE NOT OVERRIDDEN. Only optimal_swell_dir. directional_gain uses swell_window_arcs as a GATE and the optimal as the TARGET, so a corrected optimal that falls outside the spot's own arcs moves the response peak onto the right bearing but stays capped at the 0.40 soft-outside rung. Four of the ten are in that state — see each entry's arc_verdict, which was computed against the committed arcs rather than asserted. Fixing those needs hand-authored arcs, which is separate work: arcs are structurally constrained (swell_window._make_arc / _implied_span enforce span-vs-min/max consistency, _merge_open_arcs drops arcs that fail) and much harder to author by hand than a single bearing.

honolua-bay.name: Honolua Bay
honolua-bay.source: Surfline: "NNW to NNE is best to get in, NE is OK"; surf-forecast, surfertoday and surftrips all give NNW-NNE. Researched 2026-08-31.
honolua-bay.notes: Was 84 — east, through the whole of Maui — and scored dir_gain 1.000 on it while a swell from the spot's own facing scored 0.40.
honolua-bay.arc_verdict: Arc verdict, computed against the committed arcs [77-91] [161-211] [265-271] [341-47]: INSIDE, so directional_gain returns 1.00 — the optimal alone is sufficient for this spot.

spoils.name: Spoils
spoils.source: NNE/NE across three published guides. A jetty wedge north of Port Everglades where swell wraps off the jetty. Researched 2026-08-31.
spoils.notes: Was 292 — WNW, inland across the Florida peninsula. The spot's own baked NWPS wet node bears 81 at 1696 m, and its nine neighbours within 25 km all face 89-98.
spoils.arc_verdict: Arc verdict, computed against the committed arcs [13-83] [145-175] [209-243] [261-279] [297-315]: INSIDE, so directional_gain returns 1.00 — the optimal alone is sufficient for this spot.

hapuna-beach.name: Hapuna Beach
hapuna-beach.source: Surfline: "Big, winter W swells... transform Hapuna Bay's southern edge into a spectacular lefthand point-break"; deepswell and surf-forecast both say west. Researched 2026-08-31.
hapuna-beach.notes: Was 128 — SE, straight through Mauna Kea. Corroborated in-repo: the baked NWPS wet node bears 280 at 1925 m, and the hand-set orientation_deg is 285.
hapuna-beach.arc_verdict: Arc verdict, computed against the committed arcs [9-99] [117-203] [237-263] [285-311]: OUTSIDE by 3 degrees, so directional_gain caps this spot at 0.40 on its own corrected bearing. The peak moves to the right direction but the gate still excludes it; fixing that needs arcs, which this file deliberately does not carry.

suicide-s.name: Suicide's
suicide-s.source: surf-forecast: "the optimum swell angle is from the west northwest". Kohala coast, 5 km from Anaehoomalu Bay; corroborates hapuna-beach 280 on the same coast. Researched 2026-08-31.
suicide-s.notes: SLUG NOTE: proposed as 'suicides'. The roster name is "Suicide's" and both enrich._slug_for and db_import._slugify render it 'suicide-s' — the apostrophe becomes a hyphen. Was 160 (SSE, through the island) and scored dir_gain 1.000 on it.
suicide-s.arc_verdict: Arc verdict, computed against the committed arcs [65-99] [113-175] [237-265] [283-315]: INSIDE, so directional_gain returns 1.00 — the optimal alone is sufficient for this spot.

thousand-peaks-maui.name: Thousand Peaks Maui
thousand-peaks-maui.source: Ukumehame, West Maui southwest shore. Multiple guides: the summer south swells are what work there. Researched 2026-08-31.
thousand-peaks-maui.notes: SLUG NOTE: proposed as 'thousand-peaks'. The roster name is "Thousand Peaks Maui", which slugs to 'thousand-peaks-maui'. Was 60 — ENE, through the West Maui Mountains. Corroborated in-repo by the two nearest same-coast spots: Launiupoko (optimal 212, 7.3 km) and Lahaina Breakwall (optimal 188, 11.5 km).
thousand-peaks-maui.arc_verdict: Arc verdict, computed against the committed arcs [33-83] [149-159] [205-251] [349-15]: OUTSIDE by 3 degrees, so directional_gain caps this spot at 0.40 on its own corrected bearing. The peak moves to the right direction but the gate still excludes it; fixing that needs arcs, which this file deliberately does not carry.

crash-boat-beach.name: Crash Boat Beach
crash-boat-beach.source: Puerto Rico local guide table: Crash Boat swell NW. PopUp: "needs real west in the swell". Researched 2026-08-31.
crash-boat-beach.notes: Was 40 — NE, which points at Surfers Beach, Shacks and Jobos 7-10 km away across the Punta Borinquen headland — and scored dir_gain 1.000. Corroborated in-repo: the baked NWPS wet node bears 305 at 735 m, the shortest node distance in this set and so the most trustworthy.
crash-boat-beach.arc_verdict: Arc verdict, computed against the committed arcs [65-75] [97-131] [153-159] [233-247] [317-47]: OUTSIDE by 10 degrees, so directional_gain caps this spot at 0.40 on its own corrected bearing. The peak moves to the right direction but the gate still excludes it; fixing that needs arcs, which this file deliberately does not carry.

gas-chambers-aguadilla.name: Gas Chambers Aguadilla
gas-chambers-aguadilla.source: Same Puerto Rico local guide table: Gas Chamber swell NW. surf-forecast: "requires a very large north, northwest swells". Researched 2026-08-31.
gas-chambers-aguadilla.notes: SLUG NOTE: proposed as 'gas-chambers'. The roster name is "Gas Chambers Aguadilla", which slugs to 'gas-chambers-aguadilla'. Was 36 — NE, 127 degrees from the spot's own baked NWPS wet node, which bears 269 at just 256 m and agrees with the hand-set orientation of 262 to 7 degrees.
gas-chambers-aguadilla.arc_verdict: Arc verdict, computed against the committed arcs [97-123] [233-247] [317-79]: INSIDE, so directional_gain returns 1.00 — the optimal alone is sufficient for this spot. (exactly on a padded sector edge, so it is admitted but fragile if the arcs are ever re-cast)

table-tops-aguadilla.name: Table Tops Aguadilla
table-tops-aguadilla.source: Same Puerto Rico local guide table: Table Top swell NW/N/NE. It is on the north-facing coast past the airport. Researched 2026-08-31.
table-tops-aguadilla.notes: SLUG NOTE: proposed as 'table-tops'. The roster name is "Table Tops Aguadilla", which slugs to 'table-tops-aguadilla'. Was 36 — 152 degrees from its baked NWPS wet node (bearing 244 at 1448 m), the largest node/optimal divergence in the Aguadilla cluster.
table-tops-aguadilla.arc_verdict: Arc verdict, computed against the committed arcs [69-75] [93-115] [245-251] [301-327] [345-51]: INSIDE, so directional_gain returns 1.00 — the optimal alone is sufficient for this spot.

lovers-point.name: Lovers Point
lovers-point.source: Four sources say northwest: surf-forecast, surfmeteo, boarderspeak, shaman.surf. Researched 2026-08-31.
lovers-point.notes: Was 248, which points at Mole Point 4.3 km away ACROSS the Monterey Peninsula. Roster geometry, from committed coordinates: Carmel Beach bears 190, Mole Point 246, Asilomar 263, Boneyard (= Point Pinos, 36.6393/-121.9314) 314 — so everything from 190 to 263 is peninsula shoreline and the exposed sector starts just north of 314. DO NOT use this spot's baked NWPS node as a cross-check: it is the identical cell to monterey-beach's, (36.62468, -121.895), sitting 1785 m ENE alongshore rather than seaward, so its 96-degree bearing is a grid artifact of NWPS having no wet cell against the Pacific Grove shore.
lovers-point.arc_verdict: Arc verdict, computed against the committed arcs [165-175] [213-219] [253-319]: INSIDE, so directional_gain returns 1.00 — the optimal alone is sufficient for this spot.

monterey-beach.name: Monterey Beach
monterey-beach.source: WEAK — NO DIRECT SOURCE. Carried on regional grounds only: lovers-point on the same peninsula is sourced at NW by four guides, and monterey-beach sits just inside the bay from it. Researched 2026-08-31.
monterey-beach.notes: WEAKEST VALUE IN THIS FILE — revise this one first if any of these are questioned. Was 200, pointing through the Monterey Peninsula toward Carmel: from committed coordinates every bearing from 217 to 312 lands on another peninsula spot. Partially corroborated in-repo, the baked NWPS wet node bears 333 at 2669 m — genuinely offshore into the bay here, unlike lovers-point's copy of the same cell.
monterey-beach.arc_verdict: Arc verdict, computed against the committed arcs [105-111] [129-195] [225-247] [265-303]: OUTSIDE by 15 degrees, so directional_gain caps this spot at 0.40 on its own corrected bearing. The peak moves to the right direction but the gate still excludes it; fixing that needs arcs, which this file deliberately does not carry.
